content: MCP Python SDK v2.0.0 released 2026-07-28. FastMCP renamed to MCPServer; import path mcp.server.fastmcp → mcp.server.mcpserver. The @mcp.tool() decorator API stays unchanged. stdio transport still fully supported. Python requirement remains >=3.10. The v1.x line (latest: 1.28/1.29) is still available via mcp>=1.28,<2 pin and receives security fixes. Key server.py change: 'from mcp.server import MCPServer' → 'from mcp.server.mcpserver import MCPServer'. Field names camelCase→snake_case throughout. v2 is now installed by pip install mcp.
